# Trade Stations/Resonance This guide will explain Trade Stations and the Resonance that they generate. Trade Stations and Resonance are pivotal to the economy and politics of the sector.
## Imports and Bounties Every Trade Station gets a unique set of imports that can be purchased through a Cargo Request Console and unique bounties that can be viewed through a Bounty Console.
More imports become available as the Trade Station Infrastructure increases.
Bounties can be completed by individual characters or factions but they are subject to the export tax that the faction who controls the Trade Station sets.
## Infrastructure Level The Infrastructure Level is determined by [bold]the amount of Trade Nodes that are stored aboard[/bold] the Trade Station. As the infrastructure level increases a Trade Station will offer more imports and bounties. Infrastructure Level is only applied to Trade Stations which are directly controlled by a Faction.
### Trade Nodes Trade Nodes are purchased through Rumored Imports and [bold]must be stored aboard a Trade Station[/bold] to increase the Infrastructure Level and [bold]generate Resonance for the owner of the Trade Station[/bold]. Trade Nodes can be exported for $10,000 so they are expensive and must be defended.
## Controlling a Trade Station Trade Stations can only be claimed by a Level 3 Faction and it requires at least 5 Trade Nodes already be stored aboard.
[bold]If a Trade Station ever drops below 5 stored Trade Nodes it will be automatically unclaimed![/bold]
## Resonance Factions that control a Trade Station will generate 10 Resonance for each Trade Node stored aboard. This Resonance is generated every time the Trade Station Bounties refresh.
Resonance can be [bold]spent by a faction owner at the Resonance Market available through a Faction Modification Computer[/bold] The Resonance Market contains Unique Artifacts of extreme power and decisions that can shape the entire sector. Most purchases can only be made once.
## Example Purchases
### Sector Boundary increase Resonance can be contributed by all the Trade Stations to expand the sector boundary giving more space for asteroids and additional installations.
### Sector Awakening The hidden powers of the sector can be awakened unlocking tier 3 insights for all characters permanently and makes numerous other changes to the gameplay.
### Unique Artifacts Completely unique artifacts of history or power can be purchased. These artifacts can unlock Codex entries or have other powerful properties.
### New Place of Interest Powerful factions will determine which places of interest can be discovered in the available territory such as Geysers, Salvage Magnets or additional Trade Stations.
